item.title: What Is Immersive Reading? How to Read and Listen at the Same Time
item.description: Immersive reading means following the text while you listen to the audiobook. How it differs from text-to-speech, Microsoft Immersive Reader, and Audible Read & Listen, and how to try it with your own recording.
